english.title: Do an act to facilitate the commission of a breach of UK immigration law by a non UK national
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which facilitated the commission of

(A)_[a breach]_
(B)_[an attempted breach]_

of immigration law, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SECTION AND LEGISLATION ALLEGED TO HAVE BEEN / ATTEMPTED TO HAVE BEEN BREACHED..), in that **(..SPECIFY THE BREACH / ATTEMPT..), by a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was not a national of the United Kingdom, knowing or having reasonable cause for believing that the act facilitated the commission of

(C)_[a breach]_
(D)_[an attempted breach]_

of immigration law by that person and that the person was not a national of the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(1) and (6) of the Immigration Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) On the 28th June 2022, the penalty for offences under this section was increased on indictment from a maximum of 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment by section 41 of the Nationality and Borders Act 2022. For the offence applying after this date, see H100718.
(ii) The offence is in force from 23:00 on 31st December 2020.
(iii) For offences committed before that date, the offence covers facilitation of breaches of immigration law by persons who are not citizens of the European Union, see H5203/IM71104.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: maximum 14 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction increased from 2nd May 2022, see section 32(1) of the Magistrates’ Courts Act 1980 as amended by section 282(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date, see section 282(4). For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months.
